translation.name: Pab tummad karta pab Jesucristobal igal-pin mezhijad

content: María Jesúsgin ti-wawad imajad
Imi Pab-Najad-Itoged ibanerkwaje kuele, Jesús Betania-neg-kweburzhe noni. Tenal Betaniagin Jesús akpene purkwaled-akar kannan Lázaro-otulojad.
Tegin Jesús Betaniaje nonigu, tulemal Jesúsga mas imasmal Jesús-okunkal. Tenal teun Marta tulemalga mas-kunned cheikwis. Tenal Lázarodin Jesúsbak mes mesagin mas kunchimo.

Tegidgin María pude-walgwen ti-wawad-nardo-nugad cheinoni. Tenal we ti-wawad péyedzhe karkegu. Tegin María Jesús-naggin ti-wawad imas, tegin e-chagla-kiagin Jesús-nag-tinosbal. Tenal María Jesúsgin ti-wawad imasgu, pel-kwapa wawadik neg-kas.
Imi teun takalgu, Jesús-e-chapingan-walgwen-Judas-Iscariote-nugad chimo. Tenal we tule kujal manibal-Jesúsgin-akpinnonikoed-tule. Tegin Judas Maríaga chogal:

—¿Ibiga pe manigin ti-wawad ukchajuldé? Imi pe pirkagwen arpaged-wilub karkegu pe manigin ti-wawad ukchagalan. Tenal pe manigin ti-wawad ukchalen, pe Jesúsga we mani ukoen, anmal tule-wilemalad-pentagal.
Tenal teun Judas Jesúsmalga mani-chaboedga kudii. Tenal Judas kusgu mani-aturzheed-choggu, al Judas tule-wilemalad-pentakedgin kwen pinzhaszhul, pinche aga mani-kaedginbi pinzhedii.
Tegin Jesús aga e-chapinganga chogalzhun: —Pe melle weob omegin chunmama. We ome meke-chii. Imi an-yo-purkweddu, we ome anka iktualeba ti-wawad imas.
Tenal tule-wilemaladdin keg-chulgu pemal-abalgin kudiguo, pal kwen chulguojul-kuo. Tenal antin pemalbak ilgwen kwen nadguojul, an pemalbak íche wis kudiguo.

Imi teun takalgu, Judiomal-ichejul wisgusmal Jesúsde Betaniagin mai. Al Judiomal Jerusalén-akar almal Jesús-takegal. Tenal Judiomal Jesús-takegalbi kwen nonijulmal, tenal Lázaro-kannan-tullejad-takegal nonimalmo.
Tenal tule-irwal-Pabzhe-kolmalad-e-tummagan chogalmal, emalde Lázaro-mejenabmalmo.
¿Ibiga Judio-tummagan weob chogzhamal pe ebinzhe? Imi teun Lázaro-kannan-tullejadbal Judiomal-ichejul Jesúsbal-naigunonimal, tegin Jesúsgin ibzhenonimalbal.
Jesús errey-tummadyob Jerusalénzhe tognonikid
Tegin te pangin, tulemal-ichéjul-Pab-Najad-Itoged-itononimalad wisgusmal, Jesús Jerusalénzhe tanimo.
Al tulemal-Jesús-wisgusmalad uga-ka-annik Jesús-abin-nadmal. Tegin tulemal Jesús-abingusmalgu, kep pulal kolmanatapmal, chogalmal: —Jesúsye, pe-nug otummoledi-kuelen, nabirinye.
Tegin Jesús moli-burro amiapku, moligin nakwis. Imi akpene Pab-kartagin choglesgujadyob kunoni. Tenal Pab-kartagin chogdo:
Zac. 9:9

Tenal Jesús moli-burro-askin-chiid tanigujadgin, teun e-chapingan aku-itomal, ibi chogle-wede. Tenal Jesús otummolenonigu, e-chapingan kep mag-itononimal, tulemal erreyyob Jesús-otummojad, akpene-akar Pab-kartagin choglesmai.
Tegin tulemal-Jesús-takchamalad tule-pimaladga choge-natapmal: “Jesús Lázaroje kochadbal, Lázaro-otulos.”
Tegin tulemal wisgusmalgu Jesúsde Lázaro-otulos, Jesús-takpi-kualmal. Tenal tulemal wisgusmalgu Jesúsde tani, al tulemal-ichéjul Jesús-abin almal.
Al Pariseomal aga emal-emal chogalmalzhun: —Pe tak, anmal-Jesúsgin-igal-mezhijad tar-mesgal, ibga kwen kuszhul-kus. Tenal tulemal-pel-kwapa Jesúszhe irmamamimal, Jesúsbal naigugal.
Jesús aga purkoedgin chunmajad
Imi teun takalgu, Pab-Najad-Itoged-Ibe itogal, Judiomal Jerusalénzhe nonimal. Tenal Judiomalbak kwénna-kwénna Griegomal nonimalmo Pab-Tummad-nug-otummogal.

Tegin Griegomal Felipeje nonimal. Tenal Felipedin Provincia-Galileagin, Betsaida-neg-kweburgined. Tegin Griegomal Felipeje nonimalgu, Felipeje wilegal chogalmal: —Tummad, imi anmal Jesúsbak chunmabimal.
Tegin Felipe Griegomalga chogal: —An takkwelo, Jesús pemalbak chunmako-dewa. Tegin Felipe Andrészhe nad, Andrésga choggal. Tegin Andrés kep Felipebak mes Jesúszhe nadzhun Jesúsga choggal.
Tegin Andrés pél Felipe-ega-chogzhad Jesúsga chogzhagu, Jesús tule-walbogidga chogal: —¿Teobí? Tegin Jesús chogalbal: “Imi an-Te-Tule-Chunnaga wilub pato naigunoni an-nug okannolegal.

Tenal an chunchunnad pemalga chogdo: imi trigo-kwa napche arkwan-chulil, tegin trigo-kwa purkwiszhulbalil, ampa e-kwa kwakwénna peio. Tenal trigo-e-kwa purkwijal, tegin ninonikil, íchejul chanma-nonida.

“Tenal anmal-tule ampa teopí tamo. Imi tule aga changin pinzheel, yapa purkwejogel, we tule pelgunoniko. Tenal tule iti-napkin-kudiidbal aga changin nue pinzhejulil, akalzhul purkwejogel, we tule unniguo ilagwen-nadgu tullegal.
“Tenal meke-ibi-tule anka immal imabiel, an-igal-mamikid-pallí naneed-wilub. Al an pia-maídin, we tule anpak kudigumogo. Tenal tule anka immal imanail, an-Pab we tule-otummononiko.”

Tegin Jesús chogalbal: “Imi antin purkweenab-choggu, ¿an ulubgin chuli-pinzhe-itogedbal an igi Pabga chogenabdé? ¿An chogenabgweldé: ‘Pabye, pe an-wis-pentakelen, nabirinye, we wileged melle anche nonigalye?’ Chulá. Tenal antin iti-napche noni purkwegal.”
Tegin Jesús chogalbal: “Pabye, pe aga nug okannogelen, nabirinye.” Tegidgin tule-kakapurwa nikpa-akar kolnoni chogal: “Imi antin pato naga nug okannos, tegin an kannan naga nug okannonebal.”
Tenal tulemal-aka-pukmalad teob itosgu, wal-walgwen chogalmal: —Wedin, mar-koledi. Tegin tule-pimalad chogalmalmo: —¿Tegil angel Jesúsga chunmasdé?
Tegin Jesús tulemalga chogal: “Imi we kakapurwa-kolnonikid anka kwen chunmanonijul tenal pemalga chunmanoni, pemal ankin ibzhegal.
“Tenal tule-iti-napkin-pukmaladga wilub pato naigunoni, Pab Tummad sapejul tulemal-oturdagal. Tegin nia-Satanás-iti-nap-takmaid-akar onolenonimogo.
Tenal tulemal nikpa an-nazhismalal, an pel-kwapa tulemal-weine anpal naigugal.”
Imi Jesús weob chogzhadbal oyonai, ede nakrusgin purkwene.

Tenal tulemal Jesús-chogzhad itosmalgu, chogalmal: —Tenal anmal wismaldo, Moisés-igalgin choglesmai, Cristo-Pab-akpene-chogzhad-palmidagoed-tule ilagwen-nadgu tula-tio, kwen purkojul. ¿Tede ibiga pe chogzhun: ‘Te-Tule-Chunna nikpa-naigujadgin purko?’ ¿Tede toajun, Te-Tule-Chunnadé?
Tegin Jesús tulemalga chogalzhun: “Nabirdo. Imi pemalga íche neg-tallé wis nai. Tenal neg-chichid ampayo naigueddu, pe neg-taledgin nanemalo. Tenal tule-neg-chichidgin-nanemalad, wichul pia natap.

“Tenal pemal ampa neg-taled-naidgin, pe melle pengumalo neg-taledgin nanegal. Tegin pe melle ankin pengumalbalo tule-neg-taledgin-nanemaladbak naigugal. Tenal neg-taleddin choglege, an Jesús.” Tegin Jesús pel-kwapa chunmasgu, nadzhun. Tegin Jesús aga otukchajun tulemal melle e-onogal.
Judiomal Jesús-immal-taktijulmalad takchamalad, Jesúsgin yabli ibzhaszhulmal
Imi teun Jesús tulemal-wagin ichejul immal-taktijulmalad imas, tenal tulemal yabli Jesúsgin kwen ibzhaszhulmal.
Tenal tulemal-Jesús-pengujad akpene-Pab-kaka-palchoged-Isaías-chogzhad-yopí kunoni. Tenal teun Isaías chogzhado:
Tenal tulemal Jesúsbal kwen ibzhaszhulmal, akpene Isaías chogzhagujadyob:
Imi Pab purpal we tulemal-imia akalosmal,

content.text: Tegin Pab purpal we tulemal-niga okannosmal,
Tegin an purpal melle we tulemal-nudagalbal.”

content: ¿Tenal teun ibiga Isaías weob chogzha pe ebinzhe? Imi Isaías sanaledyob Jesús-takcha, otummolenai. Al Isaías Jesúsgin weob chunmanonida.

Tenal Judio-tummagan-wal-walgwen yabli Jesúsgin ibzhenonimal. Tenal Judio-tummagan-Jesúsgin-ibzhemalad Pariseo-tobedbal kwen chogzhajulmal emalde Jesúsgin ibzhasmal. Tenal we Judio-tummagan chogzhamalalen, emalde Jesúsbal naigusmal, Judio-tummagan-pimalad kantikidgin Judio-ormaked-neg-akar Judio-tummagan-Jesúsgin-ibzhenonimalad-onodmalan.
¿Ibiga Judio-tummagan weob imasmal pe ebinzhe? Imi Judio-tummagan-Jesúsgin-ibzhasmalad pul-pule tulemal-aminanimal e-nug-okannogal, pul Pab Tummad e-nug otummoedga.
Jesús-tulemalga-chunmajadbal Pab Tummad sapejul tulemal-oturdakoed
Tegin Jesús sapejul kotegu, chogalbal: “Imi tule ankin ibzhenonikil, ankinbi kwen ibzhenonijul, tenal tule-an-palmialidgin ibzhenonimo.
Tenal tule mag an-takel, mag tule-an-palmialid-takmo.
“Imi antin iti-napche kallen-kaedyob noni, tule ankin ibzhajal, we tule wisguo igi naneenab, neg-chichidgin-kudiidyob pal kwen nanaojul.

Tenal tule an-chunmaked mag itogel, tenal we tule an-chogzhadyob kwen nanejulil, an kwen chogojul-kuo we tule sapejul oturdaleged-wilub. “Tenal antin iti-napche noni, tule-iti-napkin-pukmalad-abonogal tenal tule-pukmaladgin choggal-chul, we tulemal sapejul oturdaleged-wilubmal.

“Tenal tule an-abingejulil, tegin an-chogzhad kwen abingejulbalil, we tulegin choglenoniko, wedin sapejul oturdalegenab. Tenal neg-tuku omojal, an-nega-chogzhadbal we tule Pab Tummadzhe sapejul oturdalenoniko.”
Tegin Jesús chogalbal: “Tenal an naga-itolegedbal walgwen kwen chunmajul. Tenal an-Pab-an-palmialid anka chogzhado, an ibigin chunmakenab, tegin e-chogzhadbal an tulemal-oturdakenabbal.
Al an nued wisdo, Pab-anpal-kaka-palmialid tulemal-ilgwen-nadgu-tullegal. Al meke-ibigin an chunmajal, Pab-anka-chogzhad-yopí an chunmamo. Pitomalgu.”
